title: Tractive is building an AI tool for animation-ready retopology
author: Delicious-Shower8401

comments.author: superkickstart
comments.body: Has anyone gotten into the beta yet? I signed up a  couple of months ago and haven't heard anything since.

replies.author: Delicious-Shower8401
replies.body: I'm trying to get early access

comments.author: isa_marsh
comments.body: Isn't this just quadremesher and a bunch of other similar tools ? WTF has AI got to do with it ?

replies.author: superkickstart
replies.body:
Quadremesh topology is good for static meshes and base models. The topology is still pretty bad in general. 

I'm guessing this tool is more like more automated retopoflow where you only need to mark the main contours. If it's subscribe to use then doa for me at least.

replies.author: MysteriousPepper8908
replies.body: Yeah, it looks very similar to Retopoflow but maybe uses AI to automate things a little more

replies.author: DangerousArachnid856
replies.body: btw there is quad remesher on ai steroids it is called NeurCross, google it. but it is pain in the ass to set it up

comments.author: Rubber_Rake
comments.body: Is it just me or is anyone else not seeing how this is ai? Is the first part ai and you edit it? If so, why not find a free asset on the internet? This just looks like blender.
